data.insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
specific_disease_examples: Cataract and other disorders of lens and Retina
Benign tumors, cysts, nodules, polyps including breast lumps

deductible.value: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 25 lakh (Aggregate Deductible optional)

co_payment_conditions.value: No co-payment shall apply if Insured Person from Tier 2 avails a treatment in Tier 1.
co_payment_conditions.quote: No co-payment shall apply if Insured Person from Tier 2 avails a treatment in Tier 1.
co_payment_conditions.name: Tier 2 to Tier 1 hospital treatment

initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded

pre_existing.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months

specific_diseases.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months

restoration.value: Equal to 100% of Base sum insured
restoration.quote: Equal to 100% of Base sum insured

key_exclusions.value: Investigation & Evaluation: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded.
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded.
key_exclusions.name: Investigation & Evaluation
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation

key_exclusions.value: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment.
key_exclusions.name: Rest cure and rehabilitation
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation

key_exclusions.value: Obesity/Weight control surgical treatment unless specific criteria are met
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil all the below conditions
key_exclusions.name: Obesity treatment
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation

key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex.
key_exclusions.name: Change-of-Gender treatments
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation

key_exclusions.value: Cosmetic or plastic Surgery unless for reconstruction following Accident, Burn or Cancer
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer
key_exclusions.name: Cosmetic or plastic surgery
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation (continued)

key_exclusions.value: Hazardous or Adventure Sports professional participation
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in Hazardous or Adventure sports
key_exclusions.name: Hazardous or Adventure Sports
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation (continued)

key_exclusions.value: Breach of Law with criminal intent
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.
key_exclusions.name: Breach of Law
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl04 - Standard Exclusions a. Investigation & Evaluation (continued)

key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to sterility and infertility.
key_exclusions.name: Sterility and Infertility

planned_intimation.value: At least 48 hours prior to admission
planned_intimation.quote: At least 48 hours prior to admission in Hospital in case of a planned Hospitalization

emergency_intimation.value: Within 24 hours from emergency hospitalization or before discharge
emergency_intimation.quote: Within 24 hours from the date of emergency Hospitalization required or before the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospital, whichever is earlier.

reimbursement_documents.value: Within 30 days of date of discharge for hospitalization
reimbursement_documents.quote: Reimbursement of Hospitalization, Day Care Treatment or Pre-Hospitalization Expenses | Within 30 days of date of discharge from Hospital.

free_look_period.quote: The insured person shall be allowed free look period of thirty days from date of receipt of the policy document

moratorium_period.quote: After completion of sixty continuous months of coverage (including portability and migration) in health insurance policy, no policy and claim shall be contestable

summary.overview: HDFC ERGO Optima Secure is a comprehensive indemnity-based health insurance policy offering high sum insured options up to Rs. 2 crore with unique inbuilt covers like Protect Benefit and Secure Benefit. It provides actuals room rent, automatic restoration, and generous pre and post hospitalization periods.
best_for: Individuals seeking high sum insured health coverage
Families looking for extensive base coverages with robust restoration benefits
Buyers preferring actuals room rent without sub-limits
watch_outs: Strict intimation timelines for emergency (24 hours) and planned (48 hours) hospitalizations
Exclusion of non-medical expenses unless Protect Benefit is opted
next_actions: Review the chosen sum insured and check if optional aggregate deductible or add-ons are needed
Disclose all pre-existing medical conditions truthfully to avoid future claim disputes
Note down network hospital locations and cashless request procedures

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months

risks.title: Deductible of Rs. 10,000
risks.explanation: Claims are paid only above this amount each year/claim, so smaller bills may be fully out of pocket.

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Cataract and other disorders of lens and Retina, Benign tumors, cysts, nodules, polyps including breast lumps, Stone diseases of Urogenital system, Osteoarthritis and osteoporosis) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months

risks.title: Emergency admission must be reported within 24 hours
risks.explanation: Late intimation can delay or complicate the claim.
risks.quote: Within 24 hours from the date of emergency Hospitalization required or before the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospital, whichever is earlier.
